goal: Refine chosen Compact design: Board with icon-only top-row toolbar and coherent expanded project frame.
hypothesis: A single compact header row with bare action glyphs keeps all navigation while removing toolbar clutter.
scope: Design artifacts and isolated app fixtures only; no product implementation, live user data changes or publication.

checks.description: Product source, live .workspace and previous outputs unchanged; actual prior tab evidence and both references used.

Board has one upper header row containing view/project tabs and bare action icons: Add View, Customize Columns, menu. No text labels, filled/outlined containers or secondary toolbar. Fails if any action remains below header.

Compact identity retained, all six same projects/status groups, Board/Table and Workspace App/Client Portal tabs visible; coherent expanded frame retains properties, readonly status, file tree, restore and close.
Two PNGs and local gallery/README load and explain icon mapping and static limitation: hover absence specified, not runtime verified.

supersedes_reason: User chose compact variant and requested top-row unlabeled actions without hover background.
